# Map: st-stm32-timer → timer 1.0.0

Compatible: st,stm32-timers, st,stm32-pwm  
Manual: RM0410 Rev 5 sections 23-24 (TIM1/8, TIM2-5); RM0433 Rev 8 sections 38-39 (TIM1/8, TIM2-5). Same base layout on F7 and H7.  
Features: base, pwm, capture, dma
